overview.title: Spaces & Tables
overview.subtitle: Design floor plans, place tables, and keep every room publication-ready.

aggregate.unassignedHint: Tables not yet linked to a space layout
aggregate.waitingToPlaceHint: Existing tables that are not yet on a floor plan
aggregate.maxSeatsFromTablesHint: Seat capacity from your existing tables

empty.title: Map your floor once — run service every day
empty.description: Spaces turn tables into a living floor plan. Scan a room with your phone or draw it manually, then publish when you are ready.
empty.valueScan: Phone scan builds a draft boundary and table placements in minutes
empty.valueDraw: Manual editor gives full control over walls, regions, and seats
empty.valuePublish: Publish when ready — live view and reservations stay in sync
empty.existingDescription: Your venue already has {count} tables ({seats} seats). Place them on a first floor plan, or scan/draw a new space.
empty.existingHint: Placing keeps existing table codes and QR links — nothing is recreated.
empty.placeExistingSuccess: Placed {count} tables on a new floor plan

create.title: Create a space
create.subtitle: Name the room, then choose how you want to build the layout.
create.pathTitle: How do you want to build it?
create.pathSubtitle: You can always switch later — scan results land as an editable draft.
create.pathScanBody: Pair a phone, walk the room, and import a draft layout automatically.
create.pathDrawBody: Open the layout editor and place walls, regions, and tables yourself.
create.nameRequired: Enter a name for this space

confirm.deleteBody: This removes the space and its draft layout. Tables stay in your account but become unassigned. Open bills or reservations on tables in this space will block deletion until they are closed.
confirm.archiveBody: Archived spaces leave the active list but keep their layouts. You can restore them later by creating a new draft if needed. Open activity on linked tables may block archiving.

toasts.hasDependencies: This space still has open bills or reservations

scan.pairHint: Open the scan link on your phone and enter the pair code

modal.title: Scan this space
modal.subtitle: Pair a phone, walk the room, then review the draft layout.
modal.qrAlt: QR code to open the phone scanner
modal.fallbackUrl: Or open this link on your phone
modal.waitingHint: Live status updates when the phone connects
modal.tokenMissing: Session created but the one-time link was not re-issued. Cancel and start again if you need a new QR.
modal.genericError: Something went wrong with this scan session
modal.draftApplyFailedTitle: Scan ready — draft not updated automatically
modal.draftApplyFailedBody: The space draft already had layout work. Apply will merge accepted scan tables into your existing draft (it will not wipe walls or tables you placed).

review.approximateBody: This draft is approximate (web keyframe outline — not RoomPlan / ARKit). Tables are rarely auto-detected on web; keep candidates only if they look right, then place tables in the editor.
review.readyBody: Review detected tables, then merge into the draft or open the editor.
review.noTables: No tables detected (expected for web keyframe capture). Open the editor to place tables manually.

guidance.move_slower: Move a little slower so frames stay sharp
guidance.low_light: Lighting is low — add light if you can
guidance.move_closer: Move closer to walls and furniture
guidance.area_not_captured: Keep panning so more of the room is covered
guidance.tracking_lost: Tracking jumped — pause, then continue slowly
guidance.quality_sufficient: Enough frames — you can upload now

mobile.title: Space scan
mobile.metaError: Could not load this scan session
mobile.sessionNotFound: This scan session was not found or has expired.
mobile.unsupportedBody: This browser cannot access the camera. Use a modern mobile browser over HTTPS, or open Tables → Spaces & Tables on a signed-in device and draw the layout manually.
mobile.loginForEditor: You must be signed in as staff to edit layouts. Token alone never grants account access.
mobile.staffContinue: You are signed in. Enter the pair code from the desktop to continue.
mobile.pairInstructions: Enter the 6-digit pair code shown on the desktop scan dialog.
mobile.noTokenAccess: This link only authorizes this scan — it does not log you into the business.
mobile.connectError: Could not connect — check the pair code
mobile.instructionsBody: Walk the perimeter at chest height. We capture pose keyframes to sketch an approximate room outline — the web path does not detect individual tables. Place tables in the editor after review.
mobile.tipApproximate: Approximate room outline only — no automatic table detection on web. Review, then place tables in the editor.
mobile.cancelConfirm: Stop capture and discard frames on this phone?
mobile.needMoreFrames: Capture a few more frames before uploading
mobile.realProcessing: Uploading to the real backend for processing — not a fake spinner. Web capture produces an approximate outline, not a furniture inventory.
mobile.doneBody: On desktop, open the operator dashboard → your business → Tables → Spaces & Tables to review the draft, place tables, and publish.
mobile.draftHasContent: This space draft already has layout work. Open the operator dashboard (signed-in) to merge scan tables in the editor — the phone link cannot replace operator drafts.

editor.title: Layout editor
editor.offline: Offline — changes will sync when reconnected
editor.revisionConflict: Someone else updated this layout — reload to continue
editor.discardConfirm: Discard unpublished changes and restore the last published layout?
editor.drawHintRect: Click two corners to define the room
editor.drawHintPoly: Click points for the boundary — double-click to finish
editor.setupRoomBody: Start with a rectangle size or draw a freeform boundary.
editor.roomModalBody: Enter the approximate width and length of the space.

properties.title: Properties
properties.empty: Select a table, region, or element to edit its properties.
properties.name: Name
properties.capacityMinMax: Min seats can't be higher than max seats.
properties.qrReadOnly: Linked table #{id} — manage QR from Live View

warnings.overlap: Some tables overlap — adjust before publishing
warnings.outOfBounds: A table sits outside the space boundary
warnings.emptyLayout: This space has no tables yet
warnings.missingCapacity: A table is missing seat capacity
warnings.generic: Something needs attention before you publish

publish.ready: Layout is valid and ready to publish

onboarding.step1Body: Start with a room name — dining room, patio, rooftop, or bar.
onboarding.step2Body: Import a phone scan for a fast draft, or draw the plan yourself.
onboarding.step3Body: Position seats, set capacity, and mark accessible or combinable tables.
onboarding.step4Body: Go live so Live View, reservations, and staff tools use the new plan.
onboarding.layoutStepHint: Optional — map tables onto a floor plan for Live View

liveMap.unplacedBody: Active tables that are not drawn on the published floor plan still appear here so you can open them.
liveMap.unplacedEmpty: Every active table is on this layout

assign.title: Unassigned tables
assign.body: These tables already have QR codes. Assign them to a space to place them on the floor plan — IDs and codes stay the same.
assign.empty: All tables are linked to a space
assign.success: Tables assigned — open the space editor to place them
